notes.title: Al Howin: The Curse of the Pumpkwin!
notes.content:
While all prepare for the celebration of Al Howin as expected, dark powers work in the shadows and threaten the safety of the World of Twelve. In taverns, a word jumps from lips to lips without ever being said out loud: curse. And anxiety grows while a feared date approaches: October 28th...

http://staticns.ankama.com/ankama/cms/images/273/2014/10/27/425637.jpg

To be honest, Al Howin wouldn’t really be Al Howin without one of these old curses! This year, from October 28th to November 11th, participate in our exclusive event and hunt down the trouble makers in the World of Twelve; and above all, the one that started it all: a dreadful Witch!

For this 2015 vintage, Al Howin offers you:

A unique quest setting you on the trails of the Witch, including:
An exclusive dungeon available in Astrub for the duration of the event
A legion of Cursed Gobballs.
Villagers with unusual appearance, the “Pumpkwinner”
Almokens to win.

Rewards to unlock in the game:
3 achievements linked to the Al Howin quest
2 Insignias
6 items in the theme of Al Howin
2 exclusive titles
2 Haven-Bag decorations

As you can see, this year, it’s time to get down to business! You have a curse to fight, a witch to educate, and a lot of Pumpkins to turn into soup! But don’t worry: once the threat is dealt with, you’ll have time to celebrate with a lot of costumes and sweets!

See you on October 28th and get ready to be-witched!

notes.title: Moon Island: Coming 29th of September!
notes.content:
Can you hear it? No, it’s not the beat of a tomtom sounding through the mountain passes... Nor the heavy pace of a hunting Crackler... It is the sound of a proud Moon, beating his chest to announce to one and all that he is back!

http://staticns.ankama.com/ankama/cms/images/273/2015/09/21/443264.jpg

NEW ZONE: MOON ISLAND

The news winged its way across sea and ocean with the speed of an Albatrocious. Although I wasn’t there, he said I was his friend. Which came as some surprise, I spoke into his eyes. “I thought you died alone, a long, long time ago?” “Oh no, not me. I never lost control. You’re face to face, with the Moon who sold the World - of Twelve!” No need to mince words with long speeches, Moon’s back with reinforcements and some strong reasons to return:

Level 200 unlock
2 new monster families: the Tropikokos and the Kanniballs
2 new dungeons: the Tropike Dungeon and the Kanniball Dungeon
10 new resources to be harvested: two for each gathering profession
58 new items to find, including:
- 1 Relic
- 2 Epic Items
- 4 Sets
- 15 items to craft
2 new Archmonsters: Besides the usual daily quests, a team of psyched Otomai's Disciples is offering you the chance to battle two new Archmonsters, in a completely new, communal way! 
8 new high-level runes (170+): Exquisite Runes, runes with simple bonuses (melee, ranged, single-target and AoE damage) and other brand new bonuses (MP, range etc). 
Crafting recipes from loot drops after defeating monsters, crafting items, tokens or kamas as well.
Bosses with scalable difficulty based on a new mechanic.

At a bend in the road, you might even meet Moon in the flesh - or fur, more like!

HEROES SYSTEM

You’ve been looking forward to it... And here it is! The system known as “The Heroes System,” the biggest feature in this update, allows you to play using up to 3 characters from your account. Just imagine the strategic possibilities this new system offers you, let alone the rewards in terms of your group’s ranking. 

QUEST OF NATIONS: CHAPTER 2

Following on directly from the first chapter, you have now arrived in the heart of your nation. We’ll let you find out what happens next in game! Ciao!

What, you want to know more? Hmm... Now really, is that fair? Oh, alright then! To give you an idea of what’s waiting for you, here’s a few search terms: searches, temples, archaeology and... “Dr Jones”! 

ERGONOMIC IMPROVEMENTS

There have been over 30 ergonomic improvements, including:
Feed pets with a single click.
No longer dying at the end of battle if your companion(s) are still alive.
Add some non-usable items to the shortcut bar (Resources for example).
Animation optimization.
And more!
You can read the full changelog here: http://www.wakfu.com/en/mmorpg/news/patch-notes/443421-this-island-moon

You can experience it for yourself ingame on the 29th of September... but while you wait, watch our teaser trailer below!

https://youtu.be/NNz6aLTooIg

notes.content:

You’re in for a scare… For the brave, rush online for the new update is here! Visit Forfut and Astrub too, where new nation quests wait for you. And who could forget [strike]the beautiful[/strike] Brakmar, the location of a new dungeon. 

Vacations in the World of Twelve are pretty much the same in the real world. First, one needs to read up on all of the areas to visit (the itinerary) and prepare the equipment they need. For example, what are the best spells to use in that particular destination?

Explore the streets of Astrub and take an eventual hike of a nearby mountain (no need to take the Drago-express, you can walk it in 15.)

For the more adventurous… adventurers among you, visit the dungeons and monuments that await you in popular locations.

Forfut Island has its share of attractions too: Wagnar’s Castle (Level 82) and the Miseryeum (Level 77)

notes.title: Devblog: Spell System Revamp
notes.content:
Much more than an optimization, the spell system is going to undergo a revamp that will spice up your fights and allow you to use some real strategy. By establishing a “deck” principle for active and passive spells, choice will once again be a central element in combat, making it possible to select weapons depending on the opponent!

http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2015-05-20/f36015153121557b3b3690d8a8f0f4b2.jpg

While we’re waiting for the WAKFU beta test tomorrow, here’s a preview of the spell system revamp for you.
Several reasons lie behind these changes, the chief of them being that the current spell system was based on 100 levels. At level 175, several issues became obvious, namely, the absence of player choice. Furthermore, having active spells spread over ten levels and passive spells spread over twenty levels created far too many restrictions for no real reason.
 
We have therefore decided to make changes to the system by reintroducing the concept of choice, by implementing active and passive spells across fewer levels and by rewarding the player with power spikes for unlocks (of spells, passive spells, “slots,” etc).

Decks

This is a set of spells and passive spells that you select at the beginning of a battle depending on who your opponent is. It will replace the old system and... will change everything! Effectively, it lets you put your strategy in place through the management of your spells and passive spells. Even so, there are still some rules:

You must have added a spell to your deck before you can use it in battle.
You must have added a passive spell to your deck before you can use it in battle.
You can change the spells in your deck at any time, except in combat!

Active and Passive Spells

In the past, active and passive spells used to span several levels. We have removed the part where you had to build up your active and passive spells at each level with points.
From now on, active spells have only one level. As for passive spells, these will have only one or two levels.
 
Each active and passive spell is unlocked at a specific character level and passive spells level up by themselves at certain character levels. Here’s an example: a passive spell that is unlocked at level 20 and adds +60 Dodge would level up automatically at level 120 and would add +180 Dodge.
 
All of these unlocks take place as a character levels up, from level 1 to level 200.

Elemental Spells

These have also undergone some significant changes. We increased the number of playable elemental spells by increasing the XP attributed to spells. For reference purposes, we began with a base of 5 elemental spells at level 1, increasing up to a total of 10 elemental spells at level 200. At the same time, we removed the limitation that meant a single-element character had less playable spells than a multi-element character, which has no purpose in this new system.
 
We also decided to replace the “spell lock” (padlock) system at level 100. The reason for changing this is to make this one of the level 100+ rewards, allowing players to easily alter their builds as they so wish.
In actual fact, all the changes made to this element in the previous patch mean it’s now quicker to decrease a spell’s level in favor of others if players want to change direction.

http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2015-05-21/4f8959a236739c0fbc62949d922cf5aa.png

F.A.Q

How do you add spells or passive spells to a deck?

Simply open the deck management page (the default shortcut for this is S), which is about to replace the old spell interface. When you’re in the interface, you have two ways of adding a spell:

Click on an empty spell slot, which opens up the spell page, then select the spell you want.
Click on the spell tab, which opens up the spell page (which looks like the current interface). You can then drag and drop the selected spells into the empty slots.
 
Tip for pros: You can also drag and drop spells from one deck to another to swap spells!

Spells you add to your deck will appear in exactly the same order in your spell bar.
 
This will work in exactly the same way for passive spells, but via the passive spell page.

How many spells and passive spells can I put in my deck?

The number of spell and passive spell “slots” that are available will increase with character level.

We haven’t yet decided at which levels each spell and passive spell slot will unlock, but we can already tell you that at level 200–which will soon be unlocked–you’ll have up to 12 spell slots and 6 passive spell slots.

You mention 'spells' and 'passive spells,' but what's the deal with 'elemental spells' and 'active spells?'

The new active spells will be pretty nearly as strong as your old active spells at max level. The new passive spells are different than the old ones. We removed some of their bonuses, but we also separated them out into different passive spells, and we added quite a few new ones at the same time.

Among these new passive spells, some are “simple” characteristic bonuses, some are game mechanic-based–either existing or new–and the others are spell modifiers. The latter will change how a spell works, either to make it better or just different.

The new way this works has enabled us to create more clear-cut builds for characters, with greater emphasis on character speciality preferences.

It’s great that you’re increasing the number of elemental spells! But isn’t that going to be a bit too much?

Uh, no, since the limit on how many spells are actually playable is already managed by the deck system. In any case, even after players have reached the max level–whether it be level 200 or the current max level–they’ll continue to gain spell XP and, with a lot of effort, they’ll be able to acquire every elemental spell at maximum level.

notes.title: A Blood-Curdling Update!
notes.content:
Here, it’s always night. The only other sound besides the creaking of dead trees and the icy wind is the flap-flap of bats flying through the air. As lightning rips through the sky, you see it: Vampyro Dungeon. Be afraid, Adventurers! Be very afraid! That proves that you’re still alive... Find out about the next update coming in June!

http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2015-05-15/5e2af6d4dbc8019d5e96e1ccbac6d8d5.jpg

You’ll have figured out by now that you’re on Forfut Island, where the sun never rises and the Ghouls are quite stupid. But it’s not just the island that’s out for your blood... This update will see the addition of two new dungeons, teeming with vermin that are already licking their lips in anticipation of your visit.
 
Alright, enough with the suspense. Here’s what you’ve been waiting for!

New Dungeon: The Misoleum, in Forfut (name is not yet final!)
They are the subject of many nursery rhymes told to scare the children. When you have to face them, you’ll want to call your mommy too. Meet the Bogey-Monsters (name is not yet final), a new family of monsters in the most frightening of dungeons! Level: 77

New Dungeon: The Stalagmotel, in the Sidimote Moors of Brakmar
Four new members of the Stalagmote family and a new Boss are waiting for you in this dungeon only.
Five Achievements and a Meta-Achievement.
Twelve new pieces of equipment, from rare to mythic.
Level: 52

Quest of Nations: Chapter 1/5
These new quests will guide you from one nation to the next. You’ll discover the philosophy, way of life, and specialties of each, with a new divine artifact at the end of chapter 5 to boot! Plus, each chapter will give you access to a Dungeon Adventure and its particular equipment!

PvP Arenas
There will be nine exclusive PvP arenas, so you’ll be able to get dressed to the nines to fight in these stylish places! Positioning has been reviewed to balance combat between the two teams, now all the grids are symmetrical in these arenas with such atmospheres. These arenas will be accessible from Astrub or by taking a Zaap.

New Spell System
The spell system will undergo not just an optimization, but a rework that will spice up your combat and let you implement a real strategy. By establishing a “deck” principle for active and passive spells, choice will once again be a central concept in combat, making it possible to select spells depending on the opponent!
 
So, are you happy now? Whoops, let’s try that again. Are you scared?

"I spit on your grave!" Booms Steel Beak, a promise that will only attract the craziest of adventurers! When the Black Crow equips his steel armour, he become the level 175 Ultimate Boss. Do you dare challenge him?
 
High upon the peaks of Kelba, on a windswept plateau, an opponent waits for you. You better take him seriously, because the only humour Steel Beak appreciates is black humour… and it may be at your expense if you think you can beat him with a poxy few spells!

notes.title: Migration of Steam Accounts
notes.content:
Please note that this is only relevant to players who were playing WAKFU on Phaeris. 

Here’s how to migrate your Steam accounts to the International community.
 
Scenario 1: I log in to WAKFU using an Ankama account (Phaeris) linked to a Steam account.

Your Ankama account (Phaeris) will not be accessible after the migration. In order to recover your account, you need to confirm its migration by filling the form on the migration page (available on the 13th of April, 2015.)
 
Confirm your account using your Ankama Login and password.
If your login or Nickname are already taken, please choose new ones.

We will unlink your Steam account and your Ankama account (Phaeris).

If you want to link your Steam account to your new Ankama account, connect with Steam on www.wakfu.com, and choose to link your Steam account to your migrated Ankama account.

The linking will work only if your Steam account is not already used on www.wakfu.com . If you already linked it, you will see it when you will try to connect with Steam.
 
Scenario 2: I log in to WAKFU using only a Steam account and have never linked it to an Ankama account (Remington/Nox, etc.)

If you have NEVER used your Steam account on www.wakfu.com; try to connect either via www.wakfu.com or the in-game client,  and your account will then be ready to use

The only thing left you may have to do is to choose a new nickname if yours happen to already be taken.

Scenario 3: I linked my Steam account first to my Remington/Nox account and then linked it to my Phaeris account after.

We will merge your two accounts.

By connecting with Steam, you will access your Remington, Nox etc. and Phaeris accounts.
Your nickname will be the nickname registered for Remington, Nox etc.
You will keep all your characters of Remington and Phaeris.
Your Ogrines will be the sum of the ogrines of your previous accounts.
 
Scenario 4: I linked my Steam account first to my Phaeris account, then linked my Remington/Nox account after.
 
We cannot merge your accounts, otherwise you won’t be able to access one server or the other.

You would have to send us a ticket with the following details:
Current Ankama Nickname
Name of your Highest Level Character

notes.title: Migration of Steam Accounts
notes.content:
Please note that this is only relevant to players who were playing WAKFU on Phaeris. 

Here’s how to migrate your Steam accounts to the International community.
 
Scenario 1: I log in to WAKFU using an Ankama account (Phaeris) linked to a Steam account.

Your Ankama account (Phaeris) will not be accessible after the migration. In order to recover your account, you need to confirm its migration by filling the form on the migration page (available on the 13th of April, 2015.)
 
Confirm your account using your Ankama Login and password.
If your login or Nickname are already taken, please choose new ones.

We will unlink your Steam account and your Ankama account (Phaeris).

If you want to link your Steam account to your new Ankama account, connect with Steam on www.wakfu.com, and choose to link your Steam account to your migrated Ankama account.

The linking will work only if your Steam account is not already used on www.wakfu.com . If you already linked it, you will see it when you will try to connect with Steam.
 
Scenario 2: I log in to WAKFU using only a Steam account and have never linked it to an Ankama account (Remington/Nox, etc.)

If you have NEVER used your Steam account on www.wakfu.com; try to connect either via www.wakfu.com or the in-game client,  and your account will then be ready to use

The only thing left you may have to do is to choose a new nickname if yours happen to already be taken.

Scenario 3: I linked my Steam account first to my Remington/Nox account and then linked it to my Phaeris account after.

We will merge your two accounts.

By connecting with Steam, you will access your Remington, Nox etc. and Phaeris accounts.
Your nickname will be the nickname registered for Remington, Nox etc.
You will keep all your characters of Remington and Phaeris.
Your Ogrines will be the sum of the ogrines of your previous accounts.
 
Scenario 4: I linked my Steam account first to my Phaeris account, then linked my Remington/Nox account after.
 
We cannot merge your accounts, otherwise you won’t be able to access one server or the other.

Current Ankama Nickname
Name of your Highest Level Character

notes.title: Phaeris server moves to the 'International Community.'
notes.content:
http://staticns.ankama.com/ankama/cms/images/282/2014/10/03/425032.jpg 

Phaeris will make its return to its original home in Ankama’s Head Office, in Roubaix, France on April 13, 2015. 

During this period, Phaeris will be inaccessible until the migration is completed on April 15, 2015. Players will be compensated for the 2 days down time once the server is back up. The package will be announced separately.

The migration will have some effects on the current Phaeris we all know and love but it is a necessary move to ensure that the quality of service offered to all players is equal, around the world. Over the past few months, the players in Phaeris have been plagued by numerous problems not found on the other servers -- random disconnects, connectivity issues and others that were reported via support channels and Ambassadors. While the move back home may not be a permanent solution to these issues, the Ankama team and Devs would be able to take a closer look at these issues and will predominantly be able to provide much better support to players in Phaeris. 

What's going to happen?

At this point, there are no major changes to what you already experience in Phaeris except for the following:
 
Players will have to confirm their migration through our migration page. The migration page will be available on or before April 13th.
The server time will now follow Paris Time (UTC +1) instead of GMT+8
After the Migration, players of Phaeris will also be able to access REMINGTON. You can continue your adventure in Phaeris server or have a fresh start in Remington server.
The Phaeris server item mall will now be closed. The item mall to be used will be the Remington server item mall.
Players will no longer be able to purchase rental items or stat costumes. Pre-existing stat/rental costumes will be linked to account.
Wakfu.asia will redirect to Wakfu.com
A unified Forum. No data from the Phaeris forums will be carried over – as such, we suggest that players back up their favorite guides and posts, so they can be reposted if required.

What do I need to do?
Certain data will not be carried over to the new Phaeris; this includes the
Forums - your name, rank, any content in the forums will be removed
Ankabox - messages will be deleted
Pending Gifts will be removed. Claim them before the migration, or they will be lost.
Confirm your migration via our Migration page (which will be available soon).

It is recommended to all players to backup any forum posts, Ankabox messages they want to keep, and claim any pending gifts prior to the migration as they will be deleted. Once this is complete, head over to the Migration Page to confirm the migration of your account and you’re done! 
 
Steam and LikeVN Users
A separate guide for Steam and LikeVN users will be provided soon.
 
DLC packs for the APAC community can no longer be purchased and will be available again on April the 15th, 2015 after the migration.

We would like to apologize in advance for any inconvenience caused. We sincerely hope that this move will improve your experience of Wakfu and help us serve you better. Thank you for all your support.

notes.title: Climb Kelba's Peaks
notes.content:
http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2015-04-02/574820e05a80374ec56e778e155cab1b.jpg

Epic peaks and darkened rage! Your old enemy, the Black Crow is taunting you from the peaks of Kelba. How long can you handle this? Not forever: only the amount of time necessary to get your hands on what was stolen from you with his help... And it starts at 10:00 AM server time... today!

The second part of the game update "All hands to Kelba" is open! On the other side of the bridge awaits the continuation of your quest in the heart of "Kelba’s Peaks." 

First step: your appointment with your very temporary ally Kabroc. You will need him to face the Rascaws. Will you be convincing enough to get him to bend to your will?
 
Having an ally does not necessarily means having a friend! When the time comes to settle old scores, climb the peaks of Kelba to find Black Crow’s Antechamber and confront this level 100 Boss!
 
If you get there, then consider visiting Kelba and discover its hidden places:
 
A new level 90 dungeon
Otomai quests
Merceneray Posts
 
Not to mention a special surprise reserved for the particularly curious adventurers:

- A Black Crow Harness that will reward those who have completed all the quests and all the acheivements of the zone... And of course defeated the sinister bird!

notes.title: Happy Birthday WAKFU!
notes.content:
Were you there in those early days? These past three years? It was back when the World of Twelve was reborn after Ogrest’s Chaos: the WAKFU era! And it isn’t solely an MMO, we have WAKFU comics, manga, anime series and toys. To all of those who journey with us, we want to thank you. Celebrate this weekend with a bounty of gifts! 

http://staticns.ankama.com/upload/backoffice/direct/2015-02-20/dd43d9607b80aae12de306550819c51d.jpg

The memories...

From creation to redesign, Astrub to the Divine Dimensions, Iops to Eliotropes, WAKFU has never stopped trying to seduce and surprise you… but, also, meet your needs! WAKFU exists within the transmedia universe of the Krosmoz. At the end of the year, a few special events marked these last three years: the release of the three special Wakfu series episodes, the third volume of the manga and new figurines in Krosmaster!

And our teams are working hard to continue to offer you hours of escape and excitement! So, despite the Anniversary calendar ending yesterday, the fun continues!

And the surprises!

We can’t celebrate WAKFU’s Anniversary without a plethora of gifts! Here’s what’s still in store: 

Double XP Weekend!
From Saturday the 28th of February (00:01 AM) to Sunday the 1st of March (11:59 PM server time), there will be double Combat XP, Crafting XP and Kamas for all Twelvians on Nox, Remington and Amara!

Date of the Update: Revealed!
The date of our next patch is something we know you’ve eagerly been waiting for! We can proudly announce that it will be on Tuesday the 17th of March. See you in game… but until then, prepare your party hats and confetti because it’s the WAKFU anniversary!

For the next few days, immerse yourself in the adventures of the Tofu Brotherhood with the first two episodes of WAKFU season one. Watch them for free:

Celebrating spring in the middle of February!? No, we have not lost our minds, nor have we drunk too much of that... icky fermented bamboo milk! - A main in-game quest
- Achievements
- Customization Accessories

...And also red Gobballs!
 
It is now up to you to discover the secret of the Occult Cult!

notes.title: Update: Children of the God-King
notes.content:
http://staticns.ankama.com/ankama/cms/images/282/2014/12/08/426935.jpg

Discover the contents of the upcoming update on the 9th of December: The Children of the God-King.

The Eliotropes will be beaming into the World of Twelve as the next and sixteenth class of Wakfu!

But they won't be alone, this update will also be introducing the revamped Pandawa class.

You can find the rest of the details below:

General

Restat for the Pandawa Class: Given the changes to the class with the upcoming update, a restat for spells and abilities will now be available to the Pandawa class through the previously used quest: “Restat quest system that has the class.”

Warning: for all players who already have an in process restat quest (the level 30/80 or collecting resources quests), if you are in the last stage of the quest (“I’m ready to go and see Master Kano for redistribution of my experience!”) validate this quest restat because it has the opportunity to overwrite your current quest restat quest.

If you want to enjoy your personal restat quests, we recommend that you visit the restat instance before the update. On the big day, you will have 48 hours access to a free restate spells and abilities quest. 

New Class

Eliotrope: A new class teleports into Wakfu! On the 9th of Decemeber, you can now play as the sixteenth class of the World of Twelve!

Classes

Pandawa:

Your plentiful feedback helped sculpture the class on Beta. The revamped version of the Pandawa is now on the official servers. Prepare the party and pour the bamboo milk! 

The core objectives of the revamp are:
Earth spells can now be cast while carrying the barrel. This will help to make the game fluid and facilitate bi-element or tri-element builds with Earth, Fire and Water.	Merriment and Worn-out are more dynamic with less severe penalties for Dizzy and added specialties and bonuses.	Resistance removal is now faster. The stack of resistance penalties for X amount of turns was too strong so has now been reworked to be better balanced.	Some spells are now easier to use with a higher focus on utility. Some spells had strong constraints not compensated by their effects, this has now changed to be better balanced.	Some of the random effects of the previous Pandawa class has now been removed. For example: the 20% chance of redirecting damage to the barrel. 	The Pandawa’s ability to move the location of players (via Karchamrak/Barrel Hop) has now been balanced for greater versatility.	The Pandawa has better integration of its role as a secondary tank.
You can find all the details of this redesign in this Devblog and the class page.
Barrel: When in combat, a pushed Barrel will no longer appear to players in the vicinity.

 Foggernaut: 
Bombardment: When the Foggernaut launches this spell on a target located on the Foggernaut rail, the damage will no longer be applied repeatedly.

All Classes:
 
Diagonal Spell: Spells that have a diagonal range will now function properly again.

World

Divine Dimension:
Enurado: This zone is now accessible for all players. Xelorium will now be the new early access zone.
Xelorium: The first zone of the new Divine Dimension will be unlocked during December. You will find more information on our website shortly.

Kwismas World: 
Kwismas is coming! Check our website in a few days for all of the information!

Mercenary Guild: 
Bonta - Mercenary Kara: A quest marker has been added for the Rank 1 contract - Collector Fund.

Haven World

Remington and Nox: 6 Haven Worlds will put on auction starting Monday the 15th of December at 6 PM GMT /10 AM PST / 1 PM EST. We will give you a complete list of Haven Worlds soon.

Sidekick / Pet / Mounts

Disappearance:Different errors causing the disappearance or loss of a Sidekick, Pet or Mount are now corrected. Unlink a Sidekick: When unlinking a Sidekick, other Sidekicks will no longer be temporarily unavailable.

Items

Bucket of Water: The collection of water will now increase from 10 to 100 on general wells and from 1 to 10 in Incarnam wells to help facilitate the creation of bread.

Interface

Runic Recycler: This interface will now close properly when accepting an exchange request.

notes.title: WAKFU AL HOWIN UPDATE - Free anime episode offered!
notes.content:
http://staticns.ankama.com/ankama/cms/images/273/2014/10/28/425694.jpg

Al Howin ingame event
Starting from October 29, come and celebrate Al Howin in WAKFU! The City of Astrub is plunged in darkness: Take part in the exclusive quests and go through a hell of battles in the Witch’s Lair!

Activities: During the event of Al Howin Gobball, Ghouls are invading Astrub. A short quest will allow you to unlock access to the exclusive Dungeon (available during the whole event). 

Currency: Al Howin Tokens can be obtained in the environmental quests of Astrub, with the daily quests of Katrina Slevastan, and by beating the Boss of the Witch’s Lair.

Rewards: Barter Al Howin tokens for decoration items, a costume and an exclusive accessory. You can get those items from the Token Machine in front of the Witch’s Lair. You can unlock 8 achievements, and earn Al Howin tokens and titles!

Free anime episode
As a last treat for this special period, meet the terrible Count “Vampyro” in the WAKFU anime episode we’ve made available on the game page of WAKFU (trailer section). 

DLC Packs
In addition and for a limited period, you can purchase one of the 2 new DLC packs we’ve released for the occasion: the Al Howin Pack and the Al Howin Freaking Pack. Get either of them and dress up in your Ghoul or Jack O’ costume to become the most stylish monster hunter of Al Howin!  Want to ride with class? No need to lose your head: Get the Al Howin Freaking Pack to mount your Skull-harnessed Dragon-Steed and start a hell-for-leather chase.  

http://store.steampowered.com/app/215080/
